name: neuralscape
description: Persistent agentic memory for Claude. Auto-captures conversations + per-tool observations, recalls relevant context on every session start, and exposes 7 MCP tools (recall, remember, search, project context, graph search, list, delete).

URL.title: Neuralscape service URL
URL.description: Base URL of your Neuralscape API (e.g. https://neuralscape.example.com or http://localhost:8199).

API_KEY.title: API key (optional)
API_KEY.description: Bearer token for authenticated deployments. Leave empty for local dev with no NEURALSCAPE_API_KEY set.

USER_ID.title: Your user ID
USER_ID.description: Stable identifier used to scope memories to you. Pick something short and unique (e.g. your username).

COMPILE_THRESHOLD.title: Compile threshold (observations)
COMPILE_THRESHOLD.description: Buffer size that triggers in-session compilation via UserPromptSubmit. Default: 25.

COMPILE_AGE_MIN.title: Compile age (minutes)
COMPILE_AGE_MIN.description: Buffer age (oldest entry) that triggers in-session compilation. Default: 30.
